freeze: R4-A2 training-time freeze. Written before any model was built or trained. Changes after this commit must be separate commits with before/after results.

data_roles.rule: sheet-level split; no tile from one sheet in two roles; regions 05/06/07 train, 13/14/15 validation, region 08 dev/holdout only
data_roles.08001_note: no GeoTIFF check run for 08001 in R4-A; used only through existing R1/R3 results

grid: each sheet's own GSJ GeoTIFF pixel grid (~200 dpi); affine as published, array-index convention (AREA_OR_POINT=Area -> -0.5 px); no fitting

labels.UNIT_BOUNDARY: 1 px boundary between two different labelled geo_A units (unit_boundary.npy) - evaluation truth
labels.LOW_INK_BOUNDARY: UNIT_BOUNDARY pixels with no black-hat(9px)>40 ink within 2 px (low_ink_boundary.npy) - candidate set, reported separately; a 12-sample review sheet (seed 20261029) is at runs/r4a2/audit_vis/low_ink_sample_v2.jpg (local), per-sample judgement pending human review - not treated as confirmed ink-free boundaries
labels.FAULT: 1 px geo_L faults (fault.npy) - kept, no output head
labels.REGION_INTERIOR: unit >= 0 and not within 2 px of UNIT_BOUNDARY
labels.IGNORE_EVAL: outside geo_A coverage and a 2 px image-edge band (ignore.npy)
labels.train_boundary_target: soft exp(-d^2/2) of distance to UNIT_BOUNDARY, d<=2 px; 2<d<=8 px IGNORE_TRAIN; d>8 px negative
labels.neg_candidate: printed ink >8 px from any geo_A boundary and geo_L line (neg_candidate.npy) - counted as negatives in training (they are inside the >8 px negative zone); used in evaluation for the false-positive rate
labels.m2_distance_target: distance to UNIT_BOUNDARY in px, clipped at 32, divided by 32

models.M0: R1 legend_rf_selftrain unchanged; legend swatches auto-detected on the sheet's 200 dpi JPEG (R1 detect_swatches), classification on a composite of the GeoTIFF map (0.5x) + JPEG legend strip (0.5x), labels upsampled (nearest) to the GeoTIFF grid. Semantic naming is NOT scored with any GT mapping.

M1.arch: U-Net, 4 down/4 up, base 24 channels, BatchNorm, ReLU, 3x3 convs, bilinear upsampling
M1.loss: BCE with logits on soft target, masked by IGNORE_TRAIN, pos_weight 4.0

M2.loss: M1 loss + 1.0 * L1(dist_pred, dist_target) on non-IGNORE_TRAIN pixels

optimisation.validation: every 1000 steps on 64 fixed validation tiles (seeded) from 15023/15041; keep the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss (early stopping: stop if no improvement for 5 consecutive validations)
optimisation.overfit_test: one tile, 300 steps, <=10 minutes; pass if training boundary F1@1px on that tile >= 0.9

postprocess_fixed.M1: watershed on boundary probability; markers = connected components of (p < 0.3) with area >= 50 px; result = region id map
postprocess_fixed.M2: watershed on -dist_pred; markers = connected components of (dist_pred_px >= 3) with area >= 50 px
postprocess_fixed.M0: 4-connected components of the R1 class map

metrics.primary: small-instance recall: geo_A instances with 200 <= area < 20000 px (GeoTIFF px) that have a predicted region with IoU >= 0.5 (class-agnostic)
secondary_instances: small under-segmentation: best-overlap region covers >=50% of the instance but IoU < 0.5 because the region is >2x the instance
small over-segmentation: no single region covers >=50% of the instance
absorption by a larger neighbour: best-overlap region's majority geo_A unit is a different, larger, adjacent instance
all-instance recall and >=20000 px instance recall
metrics.boundary: precision/recall/F1 of predicted region boundaries vs UNIT_BOUNDARY at 1, 2 and 3 px tolerance; recall vs PRINTED_CONTACT and vs LOW_INK_BOUNDARY separately; false-positive share = predicted boundary px within 1 px of neg_candidate ink
metrics.topology: valid polygon fraction after export, number of regions, regions < 50 px
metrics.region_quality: region upper-bound mIoU (Hungarian, evaluation only) reported separately; S1 autonomous semantics not part of R4-A2
metrics.decision_rule: M1/M2 improves over M0 only if small-instance recall on BOTH validation sheets rises and boundary-F1 changes alone are never sufficient

budget.formal_runs: one M1 and one M2 run; reruns only for a documented implementation bug, original run kept
